# 多字节𐍈边界 🎉 é́́ ‮bidi‬ test

Zero-width​joiner‍ and combining é́́́́ characters mixed with 中文文本。

## Options — 破折号分隔

- `-å`: Multibyte flag name.
- `--中文选项`, `-ö`: CJK option description with emoji 🚀.
- `--dash` — em dash delimiter after 多字节 text.
- `--dash2` – en dash delimiter.

## Code 🎈

`代码 with 🎉 emoji` and ``double `backtick` 内容``.
